# glpi_rack_model (Resource)

GLPI rack model.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "glpi_rack_model" "standard" {
  name           = "Standard 42U"
  product_number = "R-42"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the item.

### Optional

- `comment` (String) Free-form comment.
- `product_number` (String) Manufacturer product number.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) GLPI numeric ID.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by GLPI numeric ID.
terraform import glpi_rack_model.example 42
```
